page.overview:
Who is Caius Ballad?

Caius Ballad, formerly known as Paddra Ballad-Caius, is a character in the Lightning Saga, appearing as the main antagonist of Final Fantasy XIII-2 and a supporting antagonist in Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII.

In Final Fantasy XIII-2, Caius engages his fated rival, Lightning, in an endless battle in the realm of Valhalla and follows Lightning's sister, Serah, and his former protégé, Noel, on their journey through time. Caius was originally a Pulse l'Cie charged with protecting the seeress Yeul as her Guardian. In Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII, Caius continues to serve as Yeul's Guardian and he faces Lightning in battle once more.

Caius Ballad is the man Serah saw in her dream, fighting with Lightning. In 200 AF, he appears with Yeul in the village of Oerba, and attempts to administer justice for Serah and Noel's crime of changing history.

Noel seems to know this dark warrior, but is unsettled to have encountered Caius in that time period.
